firstPlayerRule: The host chooses the guest they consider the most awkward to start the first round.
clarifications: Place the Mr. Walton starting-player standee in front of that player. Their turn starts with an inquiry; turns proceed anticlockwise.
At the end of each round, pass the standee to the player on the right, who starts the next round.

internalEvidence: The publisher-hosted booklet cover names The Walton Case and shows the Megacorpin Games mark. Rendered page 8 assigns the first starter to the host's judgment, page 9 defines the first turn and anticlockwise order, and page 10 passes the standee right after a round. The 243-card case system matches inventory BGG 188866. SHA-256: 3d76b3246597be0f5926b5f2e26ae42e7da4cbeda71d1a2797406631dbddfb74. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22.
